summary_en: Toho Gas executed a ToSTNeT-3 off-market purchase of 2.5 million shares at 1,235.5 yen per share on October 30, 2026. This execution is part of a broader buyback authorization approved on the same date, which permits acquisition of up to 20 million shares (5.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 17.0 billion yen through October 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock Through Off-Market Transactions (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, Toho Gas's board of directors resolved to acquire its own shares under the Companies Act, and that same day determined specific execution terms for a portion of the authorized repurchase. The company executed a ToSTNeT-3 off-market purchase order on October 30, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. at a fixed price of 1,235.5 yen per share, which was the closing price (including final special quotation) from October 29. The execution involved 2.5 million shares, resulting in a total outlay of approximately 3.09 billion yen, representing 7.1% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. This was a time-limited order for the designated trading session with no changes to other trading systems or times.

This execution is part of a broader share repurchase authorization approved on October 29, 2026. The authorization permits acquisition of up to 20 million shares (5.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 17.0 billion yen during the period from October 30, 2026, through April 30, 2027. The company may use either ToSTNeT-3 off-market transactions or open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange for the remaining authorized repurchases. Results of the execution were to be announced after the close of the 8:45 a.m. trading session on October 30. The company noted that market conditions could result in partial or full non-execution of remaining order quantities and that purchase orders would be matched against corresponding sell orders in the market.
